versions.localizedDescription:
This is the biggest update SideInstaller has had so far. Enjoy v1, alongside iOS 27’s official release <3

# Main changes:
- Added a Tools page
    - Added “Side by Side”, which lets one iPhone/iPad wirelessly install SideInstaller on another iPhone/iPad
    - Certificates and Pairing are now in the Tools tab
    - Added a location spoofer that lets your iPhone believe you are in any location
    - Added an entitlement manager (mainly to let users add increased memory limit)
- Added partial iOS 26-17 support
    - Users on iOS 26-17 can now use SideInstaller, but only if they already have their pairing file, which they will need a pc to get
    - iOS 26-17 devices cannot use the Pairing tool
- Huge changes to the Apple ID logging in
    - 2FA now supports SMS and calls
    - Fixed the HTTP 503 error on log in
    - Session IDs are now saved and reused to avoid Apple giving rate limits
- Added support for URLs in the import .ipa
- Added a new dark and glass app icon
- Added Portuguese and Japanese (credits to @so-5699) languages

## Fixes: 

- Fixed the LV + SS nightly bug that would make it ask for the certificate’s password
- Added a LocalDevVPN start at launch
- Fixed compatibility error with LocalDevVPN’s update
- Improved the looks of the progress bar
- Fixed the import .ipa bug that didn’t let users select any file
- Reduced the amount of times the app will require to be approved in Privacy and Security
- Changing the anisette server in the settings now persists
